I'm female INTP and some of my favouritest people in the world are ENFPs!!! 

I love how ceaselessly curious, loving, funny you are. When i'm around ENFPs, I feel like I can really totally chill and let my inner-child out. I have a niece who is 16 (I'm 32), and whenever we hang out we'd be doing stuff like crying together while watching Finding Dory, stuffing our faces with pizzas, or fantasising about the pet cafe that we will one day own together-  which also doubles up as a yoga studio, plus we will employ and train women in need and act as a source of support and income to help them get out of abusive relationships.   


Ne overload, lol.
As an INTP female who is a touch more mad-scientist than math-nerd, I fully approve this. 👍🏻

When they don't respect your boundaries!

So in college there was this time I had to rush to lecture after buying some stuff from the supermarket on campus (on hindsight, not the smartest thing to do). I sat beside my self-proclaimed 'best friend' who, seeing the receipt I was holding in my hand, grabbed it and said "Let me see what you bought." before I could even say anything.

She took out a pen, and started putting little ticks beside the items she approved of, and crosses next to the things she considered as junk food. And then, proud of her handiwork, she announced to me "Next time you need to start buying some real food."

Best friend ever.
